answer_1.quote: both models share the same architecture, which trains a Q-former Transformer that connects a frozen vision encoder (ViT-g/14) to a frozen instruction-tuned language model (Flan-T5XXL) to output text based on an input image and text.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metric. Three types of questions are evaluated differently: VQA accuracy for STRING and TIME; Relaxed Accuracy for NUMERICAL.
